decisions.title: Production cache backends exclude file storage
decisions.reason: Require declared non-file default and page cache backend; explicit Varnish page-cache declaration recognized with exact Magento slash keys. Omitted page cache formerly false PASS on default Redis alone. Scope is declaration, not running Redis availability.
decisions.evidence: tests/AutomationConfigRuntimeAuditTest.php: 21 assertions; tests/AdminAclCheckTest.php PASS; tests/BasicDeploymentPoliciesTest.php:14 assertions PASS

decisions.title: Indexers are READY (no backlog)
decisions.reason: New deployment_indexers_database_ready reads indexer_state; valid rows PASS, working/invalid FAIL readiness, empty or unrecognized rows/query failure are actionable collection errors. Does not assert every extension indexer registered or queue empty.
decisions.evidence: tests/AutomationConfigRuntimeAuditTest.php: 21 assertions; tests/AdminAclCheckTest.php PASS; tests/BasicDeploymentPoliciesTest.php:14 assertions PASS

decisions.title: Session storage hardened (Redis with auth)
decisions.reason: Declared session.save=redis and nonempty string Redis credential; string 0 valid credential, array rejected; credential never emitted. Does not claim Redis ACL/network enforcement.
decisions.evidence: tests/AutomationConfigRuntimeAuditTest.php: 21 assertions; tests/AdminAclCheckTest.php PASS; tests/BasicDeploymentPoliciesTest.php:14 assertions PASS

decisions.title: Installed Magento cron entry present
decisions.reason: Installed project-specific cron:run only; missing owner crontab privileges include unavailable_sources/collection_errors and read-permission action. Repository script is insufficient.
decisions.evidence: tests/AutomationConfigRuntimeAuditTest.php: 21 assertions; tests/AdminAclCheckTest.php PASS; tests/BasicDeploymentPoliciesTest.php:14 assertions PASS

decisions.title: Cron heartbeat is recent (<= 900s)
decisions.reason: database_only:true reads MAX(executed_at) for success/running/error actual execution records. No executions FAIL, stale FAIL, future beyond60s UNKNOWN clock sync action. Existing legacy file-mtime branch remains supporting signal, not canonical proof.
decisions.evidence: tests/AutomationConfigRuntimeAuditTest.php: 21 assertions; tests/AdminAclCheckTest.php PASS; tests/BasicDeploymentPoliciesTest.php:14 assertions PASS

decisions.title: Cron backlog below threshold
decisions.reason: database_only:true counts pending cron_schedule rows scheduled_at <= scanner UTC time; future scheduled jobs excluded. Below threshold PASS; equal or above FAIL. Missing/query-denied DB UNKNOWN SELECT action. Legacy JSON negative/fractional metrics no longer accepted.
decisions.evidence: tests/AutomationConfigRuntimeAuditTest.php: 21 assertions; tests/AdminAclCheckTest.php PASS; tests/BasicDeploymentPoliciesTest.php:14 assertions PASS

decisions.title: Admin role assignments are valid
decisions.reason: DB admin_user/authorization_role/authorization_rule assignment integrity; missing tables/columns UNKNOWN, cyclic group ancestors or invalid parent type FAIL. No least-privilege claim; SQL errors redacted and SELECT/table action explicit.
decisions.evidence: tests/AutomationConfigRuntimeAuditTest.php: 21 assertions; tests/AdminAclCheckTest.php PASS; tests/BasicDeploymentPoliciesTest.php:14 assertions PASS

decisions.title: Configured admin password minimum is at least eight
decisions.reason: Configured/installed admin minimum length only; unresolvable validator or malformed setting UNKNOWN action inspect installed User module and configured minimum.
decisions.evidence: tests/AutomationConfigRuntimeAuditTest.php: 21 assertions; tests/AdminAclCheckTest.php PASS; tests/BasicDeploymentPoliciesTest.php:14 assertions PASS

decisions.title: Declared project debug settings are disabled
decisions.reason: Declared project debug flags and ini only; not blanket FPM runtime proof. Malformed flags/ini/read errors identify source in evidence.
decisions.evidence: tests/AutomationConfigRuntimeAuditTest.php: 21 assertions; tests/AdminAclCheckTest.php PASS; tests/BasicDeploymentPoliciesTest.php:14 assertions PASS

canonical_db_checks_require: Readable deployed app/etc/env.php, reachable configured DB, SELECT on relevant tables; no writes and no secret values in diagnostics
limitations: Declared configuration checks do not prove runtime extension enforcement
Legacy file heartbeat remains a heuristic only; canonical requirement must use database_only:true
Cron scheduler retention may erase all records: absence then describes current table evidence rather than cause of scheduler failure
mview queue/version readiness is not asserted by indexer_state predicate
